name: PiggyBank
tagline: An AI money companion over iMessage that predicts purchases, nudges you and suggests cheaper options.

awards: Build on the Knot TransactionLink API by Knot API
Best Use of DigitalOcean Gradient AI by MLH

problem: Everyday spending is invisible and stressful.
solution: Links bank and merchant transactions, processes receipts, predicts upcoming purchases and messages nudges and deals over iMessage, with a knowledge graph of habits.
demo_moment: Team-described: get an iMessage nudge before a predicted purchase.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Build on the Knot TransactionLink API by Knot API” and “Exploring Hybrid Intelligence by Photon” and “Best Use of DigitalOcean Gradient AI by MLH” among 195 submissions.
Lives in the user's existing messaging app.

lessons: Meeting users in iMessage removes the app-install barrier.
